subject: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acmehealth.com>, ACME Integrations <acme-ml@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health

Hi Julia / Tom —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. Per our conversation, this thread will capture the plan for ACME’s Quality Monitoring (Prompt Observatory) onboarding: prompt set handoff, eval-harness integration, regression alert thresholds, and a proposed canary + rollback matrix. Goal: agree on owners and a minimal safe canary to unblock the first internal pilot the week of 9/21.

High-level proposed plan (attachments below):
- Prompt set import: ACME exports core customer-facing prompts + expected output samples (we suggested 150-200 examples).
- Eval harness: Redwood will run nightly evals against the promptset with baseline model v1.2 and proposed v2.0 candidate.
- Regression alerts: initial thresholds set at >5% drop in top-1 exact-match or >7% increase in bad-generation rate over 3 consecutive nightly runs.
- Canary matrix: small traffic shard (2%) -> 10% -> full. Rollback triggers include latency spikes (>2x baseline p95) or quality regression above thresholds.

Attachments: qmon_promptset_v1.csv (sample prompt/expected pairs), eval_harness_playbook_v0.3.md (integration steps + runbook).

Action items to confirm:
1) ACME provides promptset CSV by EOD Tue 9/14 (owner: ACME).
2) Redwood configures nightly eval job and shares baseline metrics (owner: Soojin).
3) Define canary traffic windows and internal observer list (owner: Marissa).

Julia — can you confirm the promptset delivery ETA and whether the samples include labeled failure modes?

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — we can deliver the prompt CSV on Monday 9/14. The dataset will be ~175 rows. We will label obvious failure modes (hallucination, PII redaction misses, truncated outputs) for ~40 examples.

One question: for the eval harness, do you support fuzzy-match scoring (BLEU/ROUGE) in addition to exact-match? Some of our prompts are open-ended.

Julia

Julia Park
Product Ops, ACME Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health

Julia — yes, the eval harness supports configurable metrics: exact-match, token-F1, BLEU, and a custom heuristic for hallucination detection (we run a semantic-similarity check against ground truth and flag outputs with low similarity + high entity divergence). For open-ended prompts we'll propose a weighted metric (token-F1 + semantic-similarity).

Marissa — can you draft the initial metric configuration we should run for ACME (exact-match for canned prompts, weighted metric for open-ended)? Also recommend a 3-run smoothing window for alerts to avoid noisy single-night blips.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health

Quick draft below — please review and flag:

Proposed nightly eval config (first-pass):
- Dataset: qmon_promptset_v1.csv (175 rows)
- Metrics:
  - canned prompts: exact-match (weight 0.7) + token-F1 (weight 0.3)
  - open prompts: semantic-similarity (cosine on sentence embeddings) + token-F1 (weight 0.6/0.4)
  - hallucination score: binary heuristic flag per example (aggregated as percentage)
- Alert thresholds (3-run rolling window):
  - Exact-match drop: >5% absolute decrease vs baseline -> warning
  - Hallucination rate: >7% absolute increase -> critical
  - Latency: p95 > 2x baseline -> critical

Canary traffic plan:
- Stage 1: 0% -> internal traffic only (smoke tests)
- Stage 2: 2% production traffic for 24 hours (observe quality + latency)
- Stage 3: 10% for 48 hours (if no critical alerts)
- Stage 4: ramp to 100% in steady steps with monitor gates

Rollback matrix (triggers that force immediate rollback):
- Any single-night critical alert (hallucination or latency trigger)
- Two consecutive rolling-window criticals
- New model increases P95 latency by >2x AND increases hallucination by >3%

Owners:
- Eval config & dashboards: Marissa (Redwood)
- Canary orchestration & routing policy: Dylan (Redwood)
- Promptset questions & labeling: Julia & ACME Integrations

Related links: drive folder + Jira ticket (please add internal viewers).

If ACME is comfortable with these thresholds we can schedule the smoke run on 9/21.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health

Thanks — that looks reasonable. Two asks from our side:
1) Can you add a soft-warning for user-impacting regressions (e.g., incorrect clinical instruction) that pings our on-call Slack (#acme-ml-oncall) before it escalates to critical? We want to manually review before an automatic rollback when possible.
2) For the hallucination heuristic, can you share a short doc on how it's computed so our ML team can validate?

We'll deliver the labeled failure-mode examples by EOD 9/14. Schedule looks good for a smoke run 9/21.

-Tom

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>, Julia Park <julia.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Prompt Observatory & Canary/Rollback Matrix for ACME Health

Tom — good asks. Proposed adjustments:
- Soft-warning path: any warning-level alert (e.g., exact-match drop between 3-5% or single-night hallucination jump of 4-6%) will post to ACME Slack channel and to Redwood observers; a 1-hour human review window is opened. If ACME confirms manual rollback -> we execute. If no action in 1 hour and metric worsens to critical, automatic rollback triggers.
- Hallucination heuristic doc: attached excerpt in drive ("eval_harness_playbook_v0.3.md") — it outlines the similarity cutoff, entity divergence scoring, and examples. We'll also share a short reproducible notebook.

Next steps:
- ACME: upload prompt CSV and failure labels (due 9/14)
- Redwood: provision nightly eval, create dashboard, and set up Slack alerts (by 9/20)
- All: smoke run 9/21 (internal), 9/22 canary 2% production if smoke passes

I'll open ACME-42 in Jira and attach the runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to the smoke.

-Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
